text:
Maya Patel: kicking off annual planning offsite planning thread — need to lock date, agenda owners, and facilitation rotations. aim: align roadmap + OKRs, surface customer asks, and negotiate scope for q3/q4 launches. suggestions?
Samir Khan: +1. earlier we discussed last week to keep it late april. narrow to 2 options? one workshop day + 1 async followup day.
Diego Alvarez: i prefer mid-week to avoid travel spikes. tues-wed or wed-thu? timezone heads-up: europe folks prefer wed-thu.
Priya Desai: wed-thu works for product. can we make a hard constraint: no more than 2 concurrent breakouts per slot so eng can attend?
Maya Patel: good constraint. also want a session for customer-driven asks where PMs present top 5 asks with comms owners and launch criteria.
Samir Khan: on launch criteria — let's require: success metric, minimal acceptance test, rollback plan, and cost estimate. short template please.
Priya Desai: i can draft the template. will post in #product-docs by monday. ask: who owns facilitating the customer-asks session?
Diego Alvarez: i'd volunteer to co-facilitate with Priya for that session. can help run dot-voting for prioritization.
Eric Huang: i'll take the model/cost tradeoffs session. want to include a 30m lightning demo of the serving perf dashboard and a 15m Q&A.
Maya Patel: perfect. draft agenda skeleton below — please react with :thumbsup: if you own a slot.

```
Day 1 (Wed) - In-person
09:00 - 09:30 Welcome + objectives (Maya)
09:30 - 10:30 State of product + metrics (Samir)
10:30 - 11:00 Break
11:00 - 12:30 Customer-driven asks (Priya + Diego) — presentations + dot-vote
12:30 - 13:30 Lunch
13:30 - 14:30 Model & cost tradeoffs (Eric)
14:30 - 15:00 Break
15:00 - 16:00 Rollouts, SLAs, and Dedicated/Private commitments (Platform)
16:00 - 17:00 Breakout rounds (cross-functional)
17:00 - 17:30 Wrap + next steps

Day 2 (Thu) - Async + remote-friendly
Deep-dive docs released, alignment tickets, and followup working sessions (owners)
```

Maya Patel: also thinking about facilitation rotation: each breakout should have an assigned facilitator + a notetaker. propose a 2-week pre-offsite read packet and 3 prep sessions for owners.
Samir Khan: can we add a pre-mortem slot for high-risk launches? 30m on day1 afternoon.
Priya Desai: yes — add 30m right before wrap. also will compile customer ask one-pagers into single doc.
Diego Alvarez: logistics question: hybrid setup? need reliable A/V and a whiteboard + Miro space. ops team, pls confirm capacity.
Maya Patel: tagging ops separately, but we'll set an a/v checklist. also need dietary restrictions for in-person — send a quick form.
Eric Huang: i added the perf dashboard deck draft to drive link: https://drive.redwood/example/perf-deck
Samir Khan: timeline ask: can we finalize agenda + owners by EOD next thursday so invites go out?
Maya Patel: agreed. action items: Priya — template & one-pagers; Diego — facilitation roster; Eric — perf deck final; Samir — metrics slide; Maya — invites + A/V checklist.
Priya Desai: working on template now. will ping when done.
Diego Alvarez: i'll build the facilitation roster and ping owners for confirmation.
Offsite Bot: Calendar draft created for 2026-05-12 09:00 - 17:30 (Wed) and 2026-05-13 reserved for async followups. invites pending owner confirmations. :calendar:
Maya Patel: thanks all. will do a quick sync 1:1s with owners mid-week to unblock. any last blockers?
